entries.example: This car goes very fast. It's a fast car.
This car goes very slowly. It's a slow car.
This sentence is right. I like coffee very much. ✓
This sentence is wrong. I like very much coffee. ✗
The teacher speaks very quietly. We can't hear him.
She's a good driver. She drives well.
He's a bad driver. He drives badly.
He's speaking in a friendly way.
She's speaking in an unfriendly way.

note: Unit 19 left page uses illustrated sections (Fast and slow; Right and wrong; Loud and quiet; Well and badly; Way), not a tabular word list. Headwords are bolded in example sentences; IPA printed only for loud and quiet (partially legible). No printed pos markers, definitions or sense numbers except 'Way means how someone does something.'
